notes.title: 10th Anniversary! Wait... what?
notes.content:
Actually, this project traces back more than 10 years ago. Starting in 2008, we created a serie of web based management/strategy games.

Though the years, we gathered a small community of friends spending their lifetime into our very own world, while remaining underground by design ([i]en français seulement[/i]).

Hitting our 10th anniversary in 2018, the idea came to reboot the whole project; definitely the right time to get a fresh start.

Work started at once for a massive overhaul: moving from 2D to 3D, RTS to RPG, expanding the universe, merging all concepts alltogether... while preserving our highly cooperative gameplay.

18 months later, the work is ove... ummm, not really.
Plenty of work here before opening the gates...

Still, staring at our world now coming to life step by step, we surely look forward having you joining this journey...

[b]Welcome to Vorlaw![/b]
